item.text:
**7B.9 Research Note**

Bottom line: Scholz’s 2024 record looks mostly non-nepotistic and non-clientelist in formal staffing and transparency rules, but there are real warning signs around inner-circle appointments and attempts to contain scrutiny in the Warburg/Cum-Ex file. I found no direct 2024 evidence of patronage in pardons or procurement tied to Scholz personally.

**Evidence leaning yes**
- [Entlassung und Ernennung von Ministerinnen und Ministern der Bundesregierung](https://www.bundespraesident.de/SharedDocs/Termine/DE/Frank-Walter-Steinmeier/2024/11/241107-Entlassungen-Ernennung-Minister.html) | Bundespräsident | 7 Nov 2024 | Steinmeier appointed Jörg Kukies on Scholz’s proposal under Article 64 after Lindner’s dismissal, which is a formal constitutional staffing move rather than informal favoritism. | QIDs: 7B.9, 7B.5
- [Im Interview: Dr. Jörg Kukies, Bundesminister der Finanzen](https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Monatsberichte/Ausgabe/2024/11/Inhalte/Kapitel-2-Interview/interview-mit-joerg-kukies.html) | Bundesministerium der Finanzen | 21 Nov 2024 | Kukies described a long technocratic career in the BMF and Chancellery, plus G7/G20 and finance experience, which supports a competence-first appointment rather than family/friend patronage. | QIDs: 7B.9, 7B.5
- [Änderung des Lobbyregistergesetzes in Kraft](https://www.bundestag.de/parlament/lobbyregister/pm-240301-nl-992030) | Deutscher Bundestag | 1 Mar 2024 | The 2024 lobby-register changes expanded disclosure on concrete rulemaking, revolving-door ties, and financing sources, which cuts against hidden clientelism and opaque access. | QIDs: 7B.9, 7B.6, 7B.7
- [Bundeskabinett Ergebnisse](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/bundeskabinett-ergebnisse-2263572) | Bundesregierung | 6 Mar 2024 | The cabinet adopted the “executive footprint” and “synopsis,” improving traceability of draft laws and outside influence, which is a concrete anti-capture transparency reform. | QIDs: 7B.9, 7B.6, 7B.7
- [Scholz mahnt mehr Meinungsvielfalt in Medien an](https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/06-03-scholz-mahnt-mehr-meinungsvielfalt-in-medien-an-0-20-26278418) | Reuters via onvista | 3 Jun 2024 | Scholz publicly praised factual reporting and more diverse newsroom voices, which is evidence against hostility to independent information channels. | QIDs: 7B.9, 7B.6
- [Chancellor summer press conference 2024](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/chancellor-summer-press-conference-2024-2301040) | Federal Government | 24 Jul 2024 | Scholz subjected himself to extensive public questioning in open session, which is basic but meaningful evidence of openness rather than insulation. | QIDs: 7B.9, 7B.6
- [Germany cannot accept foreign spying and wants those responsible on trial](https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/germany-cannot-accept-spying-says-scholz-after-suspected-china-spy-arrested-3451540) | Reuters via Investing.com | 24 Apr 2024 | Scholz framed enforcement as prosecution under law, while avoiding prejudgment, which points to formal rule-of-law handling rather than loyalty-based enforcement. | QIDs: 7B.9, 7B.6, 7B.7

**Evidence leaning no**
- [As head of government on borrowed time, Scholz appoints close adviser to Finance Ministry](https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2024/11/08/as-head-of-government-on-borrowed-time-scholz-appoints-close-adviser-to-finance-ministry_6732062_4.html) | Le Monde | 8 Nov 2024 | Kukies was Scholz’s close economic adviser, so trust and personal proximity clearly mattered even if the appointee was also highly qualified. | QIDs: 7B.9, 7B.5
- [Geheimes Kanzleramts-Gutachten in Cum-ex-Affäre: Scholz darf weiter in Deckung bleiben](https://www.tagesspiegel.de/politik/geheimes-kanzleramts-gutachten-in-cum-ex-affare-scholz-darf-weiter-in-deckung-bleiben-11756357.html) | Tagesspiegel | 4 Jun 2024 | Reporting suggested the Chancellery used a legal memo to blunt a Bundestag inquiry into the Warburg affair, which is a concrete sign of trying to contain damaging scrutiny. | QIDs: 7B.9, 7B.7, 7B.6, 7B.8
- [Cum-Ex: Scholz vor U-Ausschuss - erinnert er sich heute?](https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/innenpolitik/faq-cum-ex-warburg-100.html) | tagesschau.de | 6 Dec 2024 | The inquiry remained active and contentious, with unresolved questions around political influence and Scholz’s role, which leaves a credibility cloud over clean, non-transactional governance. | QIDs: 7B.9, 7B.7, 7B.6, 7B.8
- [Insider - Regierung entscheidet "in Kürze" über Sicherheit im 5G-Netz](https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/05-23-bericht-regierung-vertagt-entscheidung-ueber-strengere-vorschriften-im-5g-netz-0-20-26275293) | Reuters via onvista | 23 May 2024 | Sensitive 5G-security decisions were handled in confidential interministerial talks and ministries declined public comment, which is a transparency weak point around a supplier-sensitive file. | QIDs: 7B.9, 7B.6, 7B.8
- [The Federal Intelligence Service’s powers to conduct strategic surveillance of international telecommunications for the purpose of detecting cyber threats are unconstitutional in part](https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html) | Bundesverfassungsgericht | 8 Nov 2024 | The Court found parts of the BND surveillance regime unconstitutional and said independent oversight was inadequate, a structural negative for clean information access and accountability. | QIDs: 7B.9, 7B.6, 7B.7, 7B.8

**Search gap**
- I did not find direct 2024 evidence of nepotistic pardons or procurement favoritism tied to Scholz personally.
- The best negative evidence is indirect: an inner-circle finance appointment, the Warburg/Cum-Ex scrutiny fight, confidential handling of a 5G file, and weak BND oversight.
- The best positive evidence is formal and procedural: technocratic appointments, strengthened lobby transparency, traceability reforms, public questioning, and due-process language in enforcement.
